title: Choir and Harvest
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Juniper Nystrom, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
